subject.title: [Feature Request] Add streamTo="parent" support for runtime="subagent"

question: Should native `runtime="subagent"` support `streamTo="parent"`, and if so which bounded, redacted child progress events may be surfaced to the parent session or channel?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the requested feature changes a child-to-parent visibility boundary that can expose sensitive tool output and must stay consistent with ACP stream policy and yielded-parent wake behavior.

options.title: Define Redacted Native Progress
options.body: Approve a bounded native progress projection that emits safe summaries through existing parent-session event paths and keeps raw tool data or reasoning hidden by default.

options.title: Keep ACP-Only Streaming
options.body: Leave `streamTo` ACP-only and document native users should use completion delivery, `sessions_yield`, and status/debug surfaces instead of live child streaming.

options.title: Add Waiting-Only Status First
options.body: Start with generic parent waiting/no-output notices for native subagents and defer child output streaming until the redaction policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Define Redacted Native Progress
recommendation.body: Approve a bounded native progress projection that emits safe summaries through existing parent-session event paths and keeps raw tool data or reasoning hidden by default.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ACP parent-stream projection and hardening work makes this the best available owner for the visibility/security decision.
